decisions.reason: The source concerns display of randomly assigned tickets and commissions, not whether successfully minted NFTs appear in the ownership listing.
The source explicitly targets the dashboard and NFT attributes, not the reward summary shown in the NFT detail view.
Displaying randomly assigned rewards does not change NFT image, cover, metadata-image, or wallet asset presentation behavior.

The source refines the existing broad no-code reward-attribute rule: randomly assigned commissions must appear in NFT attributes, while a ticket must appear only if one is actually generated and assigned.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Or is a ticket not being generated at all?

[ACCOUNT_001] It may be fine as is if a 'no code buy' does not generate a ticket (we would only need to adjust some UI notes slightly).
However, if a ticket is generated and sent out randomly but does not show on the dashboard, that will need to be fixed.
[ACCOUNT_001] Any commission sent out randomly also needs to be displayed on the dashboard/attributes.

A no code buy with a $1 tip - 0x8101c6876c85a890325f0515b97426c915f4de5807e64180f4fcb96594acc6cf

(If 'tips' are processed through a second transaction immediately after mint, that explains why the tip did not work, and a UI note will be required for this)

value_updates.random_no_code_ticket_attribute_display: If a no-code purchase generates and randomly assigns a ticket, that ticket must appear in the recipient NFT attributes; no ticket display is required when no ticket is generated.
value_updates.random_no_code_commission_attribute_disp: Any commission randomly assigned from a no-code purchase must appear in the recipient NFT attributes.
